criteria.2: the passage answers the question (contains the fact or the instructions asked for)
criteria.1: same topic, useful background, does not answer it; acceptable in the context
criteria.0: unrelated to the question; must never reach the context

method: Pooled: union of the top 5 of every method (C1-C7, before thresholds) for every question that expects knowledge, judged by hand by Fahad Zubairi on 2026-10-28. Passages missing from a pool are unjudged and count as 0, except where an answering passage was known and missed by every method; those were added so the miss counts against retrieval (D16-style concept questions, H-H3-*). Urdu-script questions whose pool had no answering passage take the answering passages of their English twin (H-EXP-UR-1, H-INC-UR-1, H-UDH-UR-1, H-PDF-UR-2).
